## Change control checklist

- [ ] Unit tests added or updated for the change (a bug fix needs a test that fails without the fix)

- [ ] [CODE_GUIDE.md](../CODE_GUIDE.md) updated if structure or workflow changed
- [ ] Database schema change? Migration and test included
- [ ] Manually checked any GUI change (the GUI is not covered by automated tests)
- [ ] AI assistance, if used, is disclosed below and the output was reviewed by a human
